summary: Intensive frontend runtime-error hunt for GlobalSearch, Planning, MaintenanceHistory, and route sweep. NO runtime errors (pageerror or React console error) were captured across all tested flows and 16 routes. App is stable.
action_items: No action required. The user-reported 'uncaught runtime errors' was NOT reproducible – almost certainly a transient hot-reload artifact during recent code edits. Recommend closing the bug or asking the user for exact stack/screenshot next time.
critical_code_review_comments: GlobalSearch.jsx: solid – early empty guard (<2 chars), debounce, click-outside, keyboard nav, .catch(() => setResults([])) on API error – no obvious crash path.
MaintenanceHistory.jsx: guards entityId, uses `active` flag to avoid setState after unmount – safe.

Planning.jsx: guards year-view render behind `summary` truthy check, uses `data.months[idx+1] || {...}` defaults – safe. `selectedEvent && !completeOpen` open-guard prevents dialog stacking. Date parsing `new Date(selectedEvent.date)` will silently NaN if backend returns null – low risk but could be defensively guarded.
Recharts warnings 'width(-1)/height(-1)' still occur during first paint (as noted); acceptable but could be silenced with a container size guard.
seed_data_creation: None. Sub-équipements list is empty in current DB (no data-testid matched subequipment-*), so search-result-subequipment path was not exercised end-to-end; searched multiple queries (hublot/manom/filtre/pompe/vanne) and none produced a subequipment category result – expected given empty collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests executed via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Registered page.on('pageerror') and page.on('console') error listeners (filtering the known Recharts width/height and aria-describedby warnings per instructions). Flows tested: login, sweep of all 16 routes, GlobalSearch queries [B, BAUER, hublot, manom, Compresseur, zzzznoresult, a, maintenance, controle, insp], keyboard nav (Arrow/Enter), clear button, click on search-result-equipment (opens /equipements + detail dialog with 25 future maintenance items rendered), click on search-result-work_order, Planning view toggle month/year, prev/next/today nav, year-month card click, event click, mark-complete-btn opening complete-dialog. Total captured errors: 0 pageerror, 0 console-error. Planning page has a networkidle timeout on initial goto (harmless – SSE/polling keeps network busy); use wait_until='domcontentloaded' instead.
rca of the issue: The 'uncaught runtime error' reported by the user could not be reproduced despite intensive interaction across every mentioned surface (GlobalSearch, Planning month+year, MaintenanceHistory in equipment detail, all 16 routes). Most likely cause: transient React hot-module-replacement error surfaced in the Create-React-App error overlay while the developer was actively editing GlobalSearch/Planning/MaintenanceHistory. Such overlays disappear on next successful compile and are not present in the currently deployed bundle. Mitigation: (a) confirm with user whether error still visible after a hard reload; (b) if it reappears, ask user for the exact stack trace shown in the overlay so we can localise; (c) no code change is warranted at this time.
